founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio:
Sean Grove builds systems that turn human intent into reliable software. At OpenAI he spent years in post‑training and alignment reasoning, helping develop model‑spec infrastructure and deliberative‑alignment techniques. He founded OneGraph (acquired by Netlify), was Principal Architect at Netlify, and now builds Linzumi.

Sean enjoys writing about himself in the third person. Sean hungry. Sean work hard.
